name: Software Engineering
definition: Designs, builds and maintains custom application software.
scope_notes: Any language/framework; technology is a tag, never a role. Packaged-platform customisation lives in pkg.

name: Quality Engineering
definition: Plans, executes and automates testing and quality assurance of software and processes.
scope_notes: Includes manual, automation, performance testing and process QA.

name: Data & Analytics
definition: Engineers, models, governs and analyses data; builds reporting and analytics.
scope_notes: GIS/geomatics work maps here or to swe with tech tag gis, not to dedicated GIS roles.

name: AI & Machine Learning
definition: Builds, deploys and governs machine learning and AI systems.
scope_notes: Data science for insight stays in data; ML/AI engineering and MLOps live here.

name: Cloud & Infrastructure
definition: Builds and runs compute, storage, cloud, platform and DevOps/SRE capabilities.
scope_notes: Per spec: platform, DevOps/SRE and middleware ops. Middleware/database administration is dba.

name: Cybersecurity
definition: Protects systems and data: security operations, engineering, testing, GRC, IAM, forensics.
scope_notes: Security architecture lives in arch (domain architect). Physical security is out of scope.

name: Architecture
definition: Enterprise, solution, technical and domain architecture.
scope_notes: All architect roles including data/security/network/cloud/business architects.

name: Delivery Management
definition: Manages projects, programmes, agile delivery, PMO and delivery risk.
scope_notes: Product ownership is pm; organisational change management is chg.

name: Product Management
definition: Owns product/service outcomes, roadmaps and backlogs.
scope_notes: Product owner, product manager, service owner.

name: Business Analysis
definition: Elicits, analyses and specifies business and system requirements and processes.
scope_notes: Packaged-platform functional analysis lives in pkg.

name: Design & UX
definition: User research, interaction/service/content/graphic design, accessibility, technical writing.

name: IT Service & Operations
definition: Service desk, end-user support, ITSM process roles, IT operations and IT management tiers.
scope_notes: Also holds IT commercial functions (vendor/contract, procurement) and business continuity.

name: Database & Middleware Administration
definition: Administers and develops on databases, middleware and web platforms.
scope_notes: Data engineering/modelling is data; database architecture is arch.

name: Networking & Telecom Engineering
definition: Designs, builds and operates networks and telecommunications.
scope_notes: Network security roles are sec; network architecture is arch.

name: Packaged Applications
definition: Configures, extends, integrates and administers packaged platforms (ERP, CRM, ITSM, insurance cores).
scope_notes: Technology IS the practice here: generic roles carry the platform as a tech tag (sap, salesforce, servicenow...). Kyle to confirm generic-vs-platform-named roles.

name: Consulting & Advisory
definition: Management and technology consulting delivered through the consulting pyramid.
scope_notes: Distinct band logic: analyst/consultant/manager/senior manager/director/partner (see band_crosswalk 'Consulting pyramid').

name: Change, Training & Communications
definition: Organisational change management, training delivery/content and programme communications.
scope_notes: ADDED vs spec draft: TBIPS stream 5 and Texas DIR both carry these titles; they are not delivery management. Non-IT adoption work bolts on here.

name: Technology Leadership
definition: C-level and head-of technology roles priced as roles, not bands.
scope_notes: ADDED vs spec draft: G-Cloud 15 and DDaT publish a 'Chief digital and data' category with its own rates (e.g. GBP 3,200/day).
